methods.description: Start at the first signed integer and move right by the positive amount. The endpoint may stay negative, cross zero or land on zero.
Start at the first signed integer and move left by the positive amount, including crossing zero. A decrease such as colder temperature is modelled by subtracting that amount.
Work through additions and subtractions of positive amounts from left to right, continuing each move from the preceding endpoint and recording each intermediate result.
